View and list workstream transitions. Create/update/delete via object
create/update/delete.



Available subcommands:

- show: Display a workstream transition by ID or the first transition

- list: List workstream_transition objects with optional filters

  Show first workstream transition
  zqk.test object wstrans show
  Show by ID
  zqk.test object wstrans show WST-001
  List all workstream transitions
  zqk.test object wstrans list

Usage:
  zqk.test object wstrans [command]

Available Commands:
  list        List workstream transitions
  show        Show a workstream transition by ID or the first transition

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)

Use "zqk.test object wstrans [command] --help" for more information about a command.
